visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman named Mika with short black hair and a red bow performs a cheerful dance routine. She wears a white baseball jersey with maroon stripes and Rakuten text. The background is a large outdoor stadium with blue seating under bright sunlight. (2) A second woman named Daiying, with her hair in a high bun and a red bow, is introduced dancing. She wears the same team jersey. The camera captures her from the waist up as she waves and smiles at the audience in the sunlit arena. (3) Both Mika and Daiying appear together, dancing in synchronized movements. The camera zooms slightly into their faces as they interact with the lens. The stadium background remains consistent with vibrant blue and green colors under a clear sky. (4) Mika is shown drinking from a black and yellow carton of Te Nong 5.1 soy milk. She closes her eyes in enjoyment before smiling and holding the carton toward the camera. Detailed view of the product's packaging and her facial expression. (5) Daiying is shown drinking from a red and white carton of the same brand. She similarly poses with a happy expression, holding the product next to her face. The lighting is warm and natural, emphasizing the product's placement. (6) Both women together hold different flavors of the soy milk, making heart gestures and pointing to the products. A final static graphic appears showcasing both product variants with large Chinese characters and the brand logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, energetic pop music with electronic synth layers and a strong rhythmic beat begins. The music is bright and upbeat, typical of a promotional jingle. No human voices are present during this opening instrumental segment. (2) A cheerful, high-pitched female voice delivers a clear narration regarding product nutrition. Her speech is fast and energetic, with high pitch variability. The BGM continues at a steady volume underneath her speech. No other background noise is audible. (3) A second female voice with a similar friendly and professional tone continues the script. She speaks with clear articulation and moderate volume. The upbeat electronic music maintains its tempo, creating a seamless transition. (4) Both female voices join in a synchronized, choral delivery of the brand's slogan. Their combined voices are loud and energetic. A short, sparkling riser SFX punctuates the end of the phrase as the music hits a final chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Kuang Chuan Te Nong 5.1 soy milk using popular cheerleaders (Rakuten Girls) to associate the product with health, energy, and a youthful lifestyle.
